div.head: Ine 6
div.ab: L. Gif hwa gefeohte on cyninges huse, sie he scyldig ealles his ierfes, ⁊ sie on cyninges dome, hwæðer he líf age þe nage.
L. Gif hwa gefeohte on kininges huse, sie he scyldig ealles . . ., hwæþ . . he lif hæbbe . . .
L. Gif hwa on cyninges huse gefeohte, sy he scyldig ealles his yrfes, ⁊ sy on cyninges dome, hweþer he lif age ðe nage.
Be gefeohtum. Gyf hwa gefeohte on cyninges huse, sy he scyldig ealles his yrfes, ⁊ sy on cyninges dome, hwæðer he lif age ðe nage.
Si quis pugnet in domo regis, totius pecunię suę reus sit, et sit in arbitrio regis, utrum uitam habeat uel non habeat.
[Be gefeohtum.] Gif hwa gefeohte on cyninges huse, sie he scyldig ealles his ierfes, ⁊ sie on cyninges dome, hwæðer he líf age þe nage.
{L} Gif hwa gefeohte on cyninges huse, sie he scyldig ealles his ierfes, ⁊ sie on cyninges dome, hwæðer he lif age þe nage.
Wenn jemand ficht im Hause des Königs, sei er [ihm] all seine Habe schuldig, und es stehe in des Königs Entscheidung, ob er sein Leben behalte oder verliere.
If someone fights in the king’s house, let him be liable [to him] for all his property, and let it be at the king’s decision whether he keeps or loses his life.
If anyone fights in the king's house, he shall forfeit all his property, and it shall be for the king to decide whether he shall be put to death or not.
If anyone fights in the king’s house, he is to forfeit all his possessions, and it is to be at the king’s judgment whether he is to keep his life or not.
If someone fights in the king’s house, let him be liable for all he owns, and let it be up to the king’s judgment whether he should keep his life or not.

note.label: develops (extends penalty)
note.quote: Æthelberht had once demanded doubled compensation for offences committed before the king. It was now an affront to the royal personage to kill anywhere.

note.label: extends same penalty
note.quote: For Ine and Alfred, it was a potentially capital crime to draw a weapon in the king's hall. The same penalty now threatened those infringing the royal mund wheresoever
